en-US.description: IPEVO Visualizer LTSE is our first accessibility software. It includes built-in assistive features for low vision users to easily navigate and adjust live images from their USB or wirelessly connected IPEVO document camera on their computer screen.
en-US.longDescription: IPEVO Visualizer LTSE is the first accessibility software designed for our document cameras. With assistive features such as voice-over, keyboard accessibility, video filters, magnifier, and reading aids built-in, low vision users can freely and easily navigate through it to adjust the live images coming from a USB or wirelessly connected IPEVO document camera using the keyboard alone.
en-US.name: Visualizer LTSE

zh-CN.description: IPEVO Visualizer LTSE 是我们的首款无障碍软件。它内置辅助功能，可帮助视力障碍用户轻松浏览和调整通过 USB 或有线连接的 IPEVO 实物展台在电脑屏幕上显示的实时图像。
zh-CN.longDescription: IPEVO Visualizer LTSE 是我们专为实物展台设计的首款无障碍软件。该软件内置语音播报、键盘操作、视频滤镜、放大镜及阅读辅助等辅助功能，让视障用户仅通过键盘即可自由便捷地调整通过 USB 或有线/无线连接的 IPEVO 实物展台传输的实时画面。
